attempts.prompt_text:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: near-square, transparent hero-side character-group illustration for the existing Dot Icon Studio home page.
Primary request: create one large, lively, premium 3D ensemble of exactly six existing companions using the attached images as separate identity references. Do not add or duplicate characters.
Input images: Image 1: blue plush Dots with fitted headphones. Image 2: rose plush Dots with clear round glasses. Image 3: lilac plush Dots with yellow bucket hat. Image 4: purple matte-rubber Grok orb. Image 5: original short chestnut-haired child in a teal knit outfit. Preserve each identity's colors, materials, eyes, head shape, and defining accessory/clothes. The sixth existing character is a bright green soft-rubber cloud-shaped Grok with the same pair of parallel slanted white capsule eyes as the purple Grok; no separate source image is attached for this one.
Subject/action: the teal-clothed child crouches naturally at the side and gently places one open hand against the large blue headphone Dots; the pink glasses Dots softly presses against the blue orb's other side, and the lilac hat Dots peeks from behind, touching the pink orb. The purple Grok orb and green Grok cloud are close companions whose rounded surfaces gently touch the Dots group; all visible eyes look toward one another or the child. The scene reads as one connected playful group, not six separate portraits.
Style/medium: consistently polished, warm premium 3D collectible-toy lighting while preserving distinct materials: fine plush for Dots and teal knit/skin/hair for the child; smooth soft-matte rubber for Grok. Match relative finish and light direction without changing family identities.
Composition/framing: near-square 1:1 transparent artboard, designed to render about 400×290 px desktop and 195×190 px mobile. Arrange six full, recognizable characters in a compact triangular cluster with strong foreground/background size variation, not a row or two rows. The blue Dots and child are the large foreground anchors, remaining companions are still individually large enough for eyes and silhouettes to read at card size. Keep every face and defining accessory visible. Use natural depth overlap only at actual body contact and preserve safe transparent margins on all four sides.
Lighting/mood: soft warm studio light, cheerful and welcoming.
Constraints: exactly these six existing characters and their family identities. The person remains an original character based only on Image 5, not any anime or cartoon screenshot.
Avoid: text, letters, logos, watermark, card border, UI, webpage mockup, environment, floor, shadow ellipse, tiny icons, repeated faces, extra characters, extra limbs, human limbs on Dots or Grok, mouths/noses/eyebrows on Dots or Grok, fur on Grok, props not listed, floating characters, row of tiny heads, cropped feet/hats/headphones.
attempts.visual_qa: root发现阻断：粉色Dots有长手臂，帽子Dots下方有紫色小手。其余构图及6个身份获认可；此稿不交付。

Input images: Image 1: original chestnut-bun-haired girl in a yellow hoodie and ivory shorts. Image 2: cream continuous-hood Meta Muse. Image 3: dusty-rose Meta Muse holding white daisies. Image 4: original seated orange Shiba. Image 5: original seated gray-eared white cat. Keep each identity's colors, face, outfit/body silhouette, material, and species traits.

The rose Muse offers one daisy from its bouquet; the girl gently touches the same flower stem with her fingertips. The cream Muse leans close beside the rose Muse, sharing its attention toward the girl and flower. At the girl's other side, the Shiba nuzzles her sleeve while the white cat presses its cheek against the Shiba's shoulder; their eyes and noses show friendly shared attention. Build one connected scene with real hand-to-stem and body-to-body contact rather than separate portraits.

Keep the human's sculpted hair and clothing separate, Meta Muse's fine plush hood and inset warm face, and the animals' fine fur and species markings distinct. Do not homogenize these materials.

Compact triangular group with clear size/depth hierarchy; girl and Shiba are larger foreground anchors, both Muse characters and cat remain large and distinct in the back/sides. All five faces readable, props held, bodies and key animal features visible, no tiny heads or two-row lineup. Keep safe transparent margins around the complete group.
Lighting/mood: warm, gentle afternoon studio illumination; welcoming and affectionate.
Constraints: use exactly the five attached existing identities; original human and animal designs only. The scene asset contains no UI or copy.
Avoid: anime pixels or recognizable anime/cartoon character copies, text, letters, logos, watermark, border, card, webpage mockup, environment, floor, separate shadow ellipse, extra characters, extra accessories, floating props, merged faces, obscured eyes, malformed hands, extra fingers, human anatomy on animals or mascot limbs on Muse, cropped ears, tail, shoes or bun.
